title: Fixed sector and formula-term query routing from audit replays
points: Stopped finance terms such as NOPAT and BMR from being treated as unsupported ticker symbols in router and admin issue scans.
Routed sector-style prompts such as sugar-sector stock screens through explicit industry ticker sets instead of out-of-universe ticker handling.
Bound sector screens to a lean market-data plus financial-statement plan so they return usable answers instead of timing out on broad multi-lane retrieval.
